title: LED burns out above 2.5 times its rated current

implements.text: The LED latches burnt when the peak current exceeds 2.5 times imax (default 20 mA, so 50 mA); the message names the computed current

mocked.text: Once the rule fires the part stays burnt until it is repaired; the real part may survive or fail more slowly

unsupported.text: Thermal history; only the threshold and its dwell are checked

validation.dataset: figures/engine/bench-solve.test.mjs: an LED straight on a pin burns and stays burnt

operatingRange.evidence: RS-08 C06 to C12: 12.5 percent off a realistic card at 0.3 mA

knownFailureCases: A real LED may survive more than 2.5 x imax briefly
